description: NIST's FTC-07, its AP242 e2 edition's sphere face #1113, near its pole, as a one-face sheet. A B-spline pcurve of its loop ends 1e-6 past the meridian line that starts at the same vertex, whose tolerance is 2.7e-5, and the checker's L5 found the loop crossing itself there. A loop crossing itself inside the tolerance of a vertex of its face now meets at that vertex Open CASCADE's healed face is not the file's: its pcurves of the two B-spline edges lie up to 0.0043 and 0.031 from their 3D curves (lengths 2.39 and 2.35), where Arris's lie within 4.6e-5, so its area may differ by up to that band, 0.083 mm² or 5.8e-3 relative; it differs by 3.7e-4. The area and inertia tolerances are that band; the centroid's is that band times the sheet's diagonal (5.25) over its area, 0.031
